messages:
Alex: Hi all — proposal: build a compact single-page Grafana view for on-call that combines a rack density heatmap, per-tenant SLO tiling, sparklines for short bursts, and a small thermals/power section. Goal is <2s load and actionable panels for 1 pager :pager:. Thoughts?

Maria: Love the idea. Can we make thresholds dynamic per-rack using 95p historical baselines so alerts aren't noisy? +1 on on-call focus.

Sam: Agree. Also add a memory-fragmentation metric (allocatable vs used pages) and a quick per-tenant GPU-share panel so SREs can eyeball noisy tenants.

Priya: For alerting, we should debounce per-rack spike alerts and only escalate when 3/5 nodes in a rack breach. Also separate thermal alarms (fan/freq) from utilization.

Alex: rough prometheus queries I sketched for the panels — put here for review:
```
# rack-level GPU utilization (avg over rack)
avg by (rack) (rate(nvidia_gpu_utilization_percent_total[2m]))

# memory fragmentation indicator (higher = more fragmentation)
(sum by (instance) (nvidia_gpu_mem_free_bytes) / sum by (instance) (nvidia_gpu_mem_total_bytes))

# thermal anomaly (compare to 95p history)
(nvidia_gpu_temp_celsius > scalar(quantile_over_time(0.95, nvidia_gpu_temp_celsius[30d])))

# power per-tenant (tenant label on allocations)
sum by (tenant) (nvidia_gpu_power_draw_watts * on(host) group_left(tenant) gpu_allocation_info{state="active"})
```

Maria: These look good. For the heatmap, we should tile racks by region and show a small sparkline overlay for 1h/6h trends. Also include a click-through to node detail panel.

Sam: UX nit: use a muted palette for historical baselines and bright for current spike to make oncall triage faster. Also add a tiny legend explaining what fragmentation ratio > 0.25 means.

Priya: rollout plan: create a staging dashboard (dash-id: 1342) with same panel IDs, test with oncall for 48h, then promote. I'll add an alert policy draft.

Alex: I'll open the PR with the dashboard JSON and the initial alert rules. Minimal panels to start: heatmap (rack), tiling SLO matrix, per-tenant power, mem fragmentation, thermals. Keep row count under 6 for mobile-friendly viewing.

InfraBot: dash-deploy:staging succeeded for dashboard 1342 by Alex — view: https://grafana.internal/d/1342/compact-gpu-fleet

Maria: When you open the PR, include the query latency numbers and panel load timings. If one panel is heavy we can offload to precomputed rollups.

Alex: Will do. PR later today. Thanks for quick feedback :thumbsup: 

Sam: Also add a small dropdown to scope by tenant or region; really helps during incidents.

Priya: I'll draft the debounce logic for alerts and share the runbook mapping rack->oncall.

Alex: Great — expect PR by EOD. If anyone wants to pair on the PromQL optimizations ping me.
